text:
sanjay: Spinning up ap-south3 account for a greenfield GPU farm. Need VPC CIDR, GPU quota requests, shared-services landing zone, and a short handoff checklist. Starting thread to coordinate.

 tess: +1. Do we have any preferred CIDR ranges? We should avoid 10.0.0.0/8 and anything currently used by corp or staging.

 leo: Proposal: main VPC 10.40.0.0/16. Subnets per AZ like 10.40.1.0/24 (compute), 10.40.2.0/24 (storage), 10.40.3.0/24 (mgmt). Keeps room for peering.

 maria: Note: staging uses 172.31.0.0/16 in other regions, so avoid 172.31.x.x. Also ask sales for customer VPC CIDRs before finalizing.

 jamie: GPU quota ask: initial pool 64x A100-80GB, ramp to 128 for onboarding. I'll open quota tickets for GCP and Azure. Need exact SKUs and a cost estimate.

 leo: GCP sample request (paste into support form):
 ```
 Project: projects/redwood-ap3
 Quota: NVIDIA A100 80GB (a100_80gb) - 64 -> 128
 Justification: Production inference cluster for Redwood Dedicated customers. Initial steady state 64 GPUs, burst to 128 for onboarding. Contact: jamie@redwood.ai
 ```

 leo: Azure SKU example: Standard_ND96asr_A100_v4. For AWS look at p4de.24xlarge / p4d.

 jamie: Cost back-of-envelope: 64 A100s @ $X/hr -> ~ $Y/day. I'll add to the ticket. We should also budget NAT costs (egress), private interconnect, and cross-region replication traffic.

 infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4453 for GCP GPU quota request and INF-4454 for Azure quota request. Links: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4453

 tess: Networking checklist quick:
 - VPC CIDR approved
 - Private DNS and DHCP options
 - Route table for peering to shared-services
 - Cloud NAT/egress architecture (single NAT vs per-subnet)
 - Firewall: allow control-plane ports (ssh, kube-api, health checks)

 maria: For peering: ensure routes don't leak to customer peered VPCs. Use route priority and advertised ranges. Also restrict peering to service accounts used by infra.

 leo: Terraform snippet for VPC (skeleton):
 ```
 module "vpc" {
   source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/infra-vpc-module.git//gcp"
   name   = "ap-south3-core"
   cidr   = "10.40.0.0/16"
   subnets = {
     compute = "10.40.1.0/24"
     storage = "10.40.2.0/24"
   }
 }
 ```

 sanjay: Ownership/next steps:
 - jamie: open quota tickets + cost estimate (INF-4453/4)
 - leo: create TF PR for VPC module + subnet tagging
 - tess: validate firewall rules + NAT approach
 - maria: confirm no CIDR conflicts with customers
 I'll schedule a 30min handoff tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Ping me if anything blocks.

 tess: lgtm. I'll start firewall template and post PR link.

 jamie: filing cost ticket now. will share ETA in INF-4453.

 maria: pinged account execs for customer CIDRs.

 leo: PR created: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pull/726 - includes VPC + subnet map. tagging @tess for firewall.

 sanjay: Great progress. If quota approvals come in before handoff, we'll run the validator script and open the cluster bootstrap job.

 leo: Validator command (run in CI)
 ```
 ./tools/region-validator --project=redwood-ap3 --vpc=10.40.0.0/16 --subnets=10.40.1.0/24,10.40.2.0/24
 ```

 sanjay: Thanks all. Handoff tomorrow 09:00 UTC unless blockers show up. :rocket:
